name: idea-scout
description: Idea Scout — identity-aware startup idea discovery. Reads a founder's own profile, takes a build-type category and a complexity preference, dispatches angle-specific research agents over web search, and returns 5–10 ranked candidate ideas each carrying a viability scorecard compatible with the Ideation Engine's, so a promising one can be pressure-tested straight away.
author: Biffo Team

columns.name: owner_sub
columns.description: Cognito sub of the founder who owns this run — the owner-scope column for service access (ADR-0017 §5). All reads/writes go through Core's owner-scoped service routes; the table is NOT exposed via generic CRUD (which is tenant-scoped, not owner-scoped).

columns.name: build_type
columns.description: The `key` of the idea_scout_build_types row this run was started for. A plain key, not a foreign key — plugin tables cannot declare FKs; the service validates it against the active list at start time.

columns.name: complexity
columns.description: The founder's complexity preference, 1 (small and niche) to 5 (high-complexity). Feeds the research brief; not a filter.

columns.name: status
columns.description: researching | synthesising | complete | failed. Nullable because the generated migration DDL does not apply declared defaults (only the in-process model) — the service sets it explicitly on create.

columns.name: chain_id
columns.description: The causation chain this run's agent runs share (ADR-0014 §8). Generated before the agent runs are requested — it cannot be the run's own id, because the row does not exist yet — and passed as causation_id on all three research runs so the orchestration engine's agent_fan_in can find them as siblings. Also how this plugin finds the synthesis run the engine created on its behalf.

columns.name: research_run_ids
columns.description: The async agent-runtime run ids of this run's parallel research agents, as a JSON array string. Text, not JSON: Core's plugin-table type map has no JSON type, and an unknown type silently falls back to String, which would truncate.

columns.name: synthesis_run_id
columns.description: The async run that reconciled the research findings into ranked candidates. Set when the research fan-in completes.

columns.name: profile_snapshot
columns.description: The founder profile the agents actually saw, as a JSON object string. Snapshotted so a run stays explicable after the founder edits their profile.

columns.name: failure_reason
columns.description: Why a failed run failed, in terms a founder can read. Null unless status is failed.

columns.name: deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True means the founder removed this run from their sidebar; the row is never destroyed, just excluded from list_runs. Nullable for the same declared-default reason as status — treat NULL as false.

columns.name: owner_sub
columns.description: Cognito sub of the founder who owns this candidate — denormalised from the run so candidates are owner-scoped uniformly, without a join (ADR-0017 §5).

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: The idea_scout_runs row that produced this candidate.

columns.name: rank
columns.description: 1-based position in the synthesis agent's ranking. Stored rather than derived so the founder always sees the order the agent argued for.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Short name for the idea.

columns.name: pitch
columns.description: The idea itself, in a few sentences. This is what gets carried into the Ideation Engine as the seed idea when a founder promotes the candidate.

columns.name: scorecard
columns.description: The viability scorecard as a JSON string (shape: idea_scout.definitions.Scorecard, deliberately the same four axes as the Ideation Engine's). Text for the same no-JSON-type reason as above.

columns.name: sources
columns.description: The evidence the agents cited for this candidate, as a JSON array string of {url, note} objects.

columns.name: model
columns.description: The model that produced this candidate.

columns.name: key
columns.description: Stable identifier stored on a run (e.g. 'micro-saas'). Relabelling must not orphan existing runs, so the key is what a run references.

columns.name: label
columns.description: What the founder sees in the build-type picker (e.g. 'MicroSaaS').

columns.name: description
columns.description: One line on what this category means and what it implies for scope — shown under the label in the picker, and included in the research brief so the agents scope to it.

columns.name: active
columns.description: Whether this category is offered today. Nullable because the generated migration DDL does not apply declared defaults — treat NULL as false; every create request sets it explicitly.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.description: Display order in the picker, ascending. Ties fall back to label.

api_routes.description: List build-type categories. Readable by any authenticated caller — the founder's run form needs it — while only an admin can change the list.
Update a build-type category — relabel, re-describe, reorder, or toggle active (admin only).
Remove a build-type category (admin only). Prefer setting active=false: existing runs reference the key.
